## What changes

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

Record the checks you ran and their results. Include screenshots for visible changes and a native check for affected desktop behavior.

## Compatibility

Explain any effect on saved settings, user files, synchronization or packaging. Mention migrations, new dependencies and licensing considerations when relevant.
